summary: This lecture from Shaykh Ali Mashhour's Zadul-Ma'ad series (Part 145) discusses the miracles of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as documented in authentic Islamic sources. The session focuses on specific miracles including the Prophet's supplication for Ibn Abbas to be granted understanding of the deen and Quranic interpretation, which resulted in Ibn Abbas becoming renowned as the greatest Quranic exegete among the companions. The lecture also covers miracles such as the Prophet's dua for rain during a drought, his blessing for Abu Talha and Um Salamah which resulted in nine scholarly sons, the conversion of Abu Hurairah's mother through the Prophet's supplication, and various other documented miracles including the scattering of dust over Quraysh enemies and protection during the Hijra night.
suggested_title: Miracles of the Prophet Muhammad and Divine Answers to His Supplications - Zadul-Ma'ad Part 145
catchy_title: When the Prophet's Dua Changed Lives Forever
